changes: Translated Tiger V1 three-pass compression to portable TypeScript BigInt with explicit unsigned 64-bit wrapping.
Replaced Rust digest framework buffering with bounded 64-byte tail and non-destructive full 24-byte digest snapshots. No Tiger2 or game-specific truncation.
S-box tables: tables.bin is exactly 1024 consecutive uint64 little-endian words; generated tiger-tables.ts preserves index order as BigInt literals in one frozen private array.
No Rust dependencies or framework code are copied into the runtime.

derivedTables.mapping: word i = uint64 little-endian at byte 8*i in upstream tables.bin; four 256-word S-boxes in source order
